title: Standalone activities
description: The activity types one commit of a repository declares that none of its workflows calls. Such activities have no place in a workflow diagram; a Temporal server can run them on their own.

commit.description: Commit of the analysed repository the list was produced from.

modelMode.description: How the source model was obtained.

activities.description: Activity types no workflow has a step for, ordered by activity type and then by interface.

unresolvedWorkflows.description: Workflow types with a call the analysis could not follow, or without a graph, ordered by name. A listed activity may be called from one of them.

name.description: Activity type name as registered with Temporal.

interface.description: Fully qualified name of the activity interface that declares the activity.

module.description: Module that declares the interface. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

loc.description: Where the method is declared. Absent if the interface comes from a library.

file.description: Path relative to the root of the analysed repository, with / separators.
